Name: MATERIAL_EX_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the configuration of material parameters.

Fields.Name: Material Param Name
Fields.Description: Set the parameter name of the material. Up to 31 characters.

Fields.Name: Material ID
Fields.Description: Which of the model's materials receive the override, for NpcParam resident material overrides. -1: every material.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value: R
Fields.Description: First component of the value written to the parameter (R for colours). Used by NpcParam resident material overrides.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value: G
Fields.Description: Second component of the value written to the parameter (G for colours). Used by NpcParam resident material overrides.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value: B
Fields.Description: Third component of the value written to the parameter (B for colours). Used by NpcParam resident material overrides.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value: Alpha
Fields.Description: Fourth component of the value written to the parameter (A for colours). Used by NpcParam resident material overrides.

Fields.Name: Material Param Value: Intensity
Fields.Description: Fifth component of the value written to the parameter (usually intensity). Used by NpcParam resident material overrides.
